lxc_8645515792237da5.text: Meet two very different players and their volleyball team.

lxc_acfecea0cd0d26d7.text: Follow how their skills work together, and learn what happens on the court.

lxc_3a51741608368b5a.text: is a Japanese manga about volleyball.

lxc_57ea1e527c55e8ab.text: A manga is a story told through words and pictures.

lxc_e1a48c488e3a1614.text: Haruichi Furudate wrote and drew it.

lxc_f4dbb07985e4471a.text: It appeared in the magazine Weekly Shonen Jump from 2012 to 2020.

lxc_5d487d61d8c13101.text: The complete manga has 45 volumes, or books.

lxc_663dde20e64d744d.text: Production I.G made the TV anime.

lxc_8989702bcc83f7d8.text: The anime brings the players, games, and sounds to the screen.

lxc_5d517b309a224bed.text: By December 2025, the manga had over 75 million copies in circulation.

lxc_f804d466c75cf315.text: Its story follows players who learn to use their different skills together.

lxc_e6cb80f173a4ee1f.text: Shoyo Hinata is short, but he is very fast and can jump very high.

lxc_543ca4453564dec2.text: While he is in junior high school, he sees Karasuno High School play volleyball on TV.

lxc_42b8b51efa41b73d.text: One short player catches his attention.

lxc_0697d24956408f0a.text: This player is called the Little Giant.

lxc_cf82ba661cdf1b44.text: He wants to play like him.

lxc_8f75803e52cfd6f1.text: However, Hinata’s own volleyball club has almost no members.

lxc_26a274abcdf72023.text: His dream starts before he has a strong team.

lxc_6e7821e8a09e8eb4.text: His height does not stop him from wanting to play.

lxc_8fa0ab3169bacb4f.text: His speed and jump give him something important to build on.

lxc_5035464e942df640.text: Tobio Kageyama is a genius setter.

lxc_8674ab3218c8bf5a.text: A setter sends the ball into a good place for another player to hit.

lxc_5bfa0d47db54a8af.text: Kageyama can do this very well.

lxc_740ededfd945327a.text: People call him the King of the Court because of his skill and his bossy way of treating others.

lxc_e89566a9d07aa84b.text: Hinata’s team loses badly to Kageyama’s team in junior high school.

lxc_dd6b95b35ab4c689.text: Later, Hinata goes to Karasuno, hoping to beat him.

lxc_ad8763ce79400c53.text: They are now on the same team.

lxc_50bb2b4b3bfa2cf2.text: The rivals must learn to become partners, not just strong players on their own.

lxc_6cc72a125caf1e94.text: Karasuno High School once had a strong volleyball team.

lxc_31641d31090184f4.text: The Little Giant played for Karasuno at the national tournament.

lxc_8834cb1bf2cd8b8d.text: Later, the team was no longer as strong.

lxc_90ef5312b486b46c.text: Other teams began calling it the Wingless Crows.

lxc_cf6f29292e5ed9a4.text: The name suggests birds that cannot fly.

lxc_90bf7a25d76c5358.text: Now Karasuno wants to return to the Nationals, a tournament with teams from across Japan.

lxc_908f9ac2a0f0d7f9.text: Hinata and Kageyama become part of this effort.

lxc_fb14734cef1aafaf.text: The goal is bigger than their personal rivalry.

lxc_6e4787136d12677e.text: Karasuno needs its players to work together so the team can become strong again.

lxc_5a66246886183f18.text: In indoor volleyball, each team has six players on the court.

lxc_04bad3d4aa742954.text: A rally starts with a serve from behind the end line.

lxc_d4717c5f031e85bb.text: The teams then send the ball back and forth.

lxc_de9d6abfcb635316.text: A team has up to three touches before returning the ball.

lxc_e2bbfbf94b94b041.text: A common pattern is receive, set, and spike.

lxc_f4c5e10c0fa1caaa.text: Players receive the ball, set it up, then hit it over the net.

lxc_08103a45546fc413.text: Every rally gives one team a point.

lxc_7b8ff9507f4ced3a.text: A team scores when the ball lands on the other side or the other team makes a mistake.

lxc_2747822712aa5942.text: Most sets go to 25 points, with a two-point lead needed to win.

lxc_659f4b40ea2cb6b3.text: The setter sets up the ball.

lxc_9680cb1983adfccc.text: A wing spiker attacks from the sides near the net.

lxc_0dd3aedca0156161.text: A middle blocker plays near the centre of the net and blocks or attacks.

lxc_acd494aab6eca6a9.text: A libero helps defend in the back row and wears a different-colour shirt.

lxc_66c8842c2e4db78c.text: A block is a jump at the net to stop an attack.

lxc_8dab8990d178a7f6.text: Hinata and Kageyama use a quick attack.

lxc_6ef36743989eed44.text: Kageyama sends a low, fast set while Hinata is already jumping.

lxc_b51e5b4ebf12dce7.text: Hinata’s speed and jump meet Kageyama’s skill.

lxc_03f5b370ace57dc9.text: They need good timing and trust.

lxc_fe3ba77c9608af3b.text: One player’s strength becomes more useful when it connects with another player’s strength.
